INCIDENT TYPE:
TOKEN THEFT

DESCRIPTION:
Attackers steal authentication tokens to access cloud services, APIs, and enterprise applications without requiring passwords.

THREAT FRAMEWORK:
- MITRE ATT&CK | T1528 | Steal Application Access Token

INDICATORS:
- Unauthorized API access
- Unexpected token usage
- Cloud access anomalies

DETECTION RULES:
- Token reuse anomalies
- Suspicious cloud access

AFFECTED ASSETS:
- Cloud platforms
- APIs
- Enterprise applications
